summary: Phase C frontend redesign tested end-to-end on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) using public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 4 redesigned screens (Notice Board, Complaints, Haat Bazaar, Resident MyBills, Admin MaintenanceBills) verified — UI elements, data-testids, modals, FABs, filter chips, detail dialog, hero cards, batch chips, summary stat-cards all render and integrate correctly with backend. No regressions in Phase A/B (auth, role accents, bottom-nav still pass). One minor a11y warning observed.

design_issues.screen: All shadcn dialogs (Notice/Complaint create, Complaint detail, Generate Bills, Pay)
issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Accessibility-only warning (not blocking). Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to each DialogContent.

passed_tests: Admin Notices /admin/notices: notices-page renders; desktop create-notice-btn visible; modal opens with notice-title-input + notice-content-input + pin checkbox; submitting pinned notice -> 'Pinned' label appears + 1 card; submitting non-pinned -> 'All notices' label appears + 2 cards; delete-notice-{id} removes card (confirm dialog auto-accepted) -> 1 card remaining
Mobile (390x844) Admin Notices: create-notice-fab visible; desktop create-notice-btn hidden (sm:flex correctly enforced)

Admin Complaints /admin/complaints: complaints-page renders; all 4 filter chips render (filter-all/open/in-progress/resolved) and click without error; detail-status-{open|in_progress|resolved|closed} buttons render only for admin; status update click reflected (verified later via resident-created complaint)

Resident Complaints /resident/complaints: page loads; desktop create-complaint-btn opens modal with title/category/priority/description; submit creates complaint -> complaint-card-{id} renders; clicking card opens complaint-detail dialog; resident does NOT see detail-status-* panel (canManage=false correctly enforced); mobile create-complaint-fab visible at 390x844
Resident Bazaar /resident/bazaar: bazaar-page + bazaar-hero render; 'How it works' card visible with steps

Resident MyBills /resident/bills: my-bills-page + bills-summary-hero render; pay-next-btn visible (pending bill exists); 1 bill-row-{id} for Mar 2026; clicking pay-next opens pay modal with payment-mode-select + payment-ref-input

Admin Maintenance /admin/maintenance: maintenance-bills-page + batch-chips + bills-summary (4 stat-cards) render; generate-bills-btn opens modal; preview-btn click loads preview (3 stat-cards + flat list)
Mobile bottom-nav still present at 390x844 (regression pass)
action_items: (Low priority a11y) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby={undefined} suppression to DialogContent across SharedPages.js (NoticesPage modal, ComplaintsPage modal + detail), ResidentPages.js (Pay modal), MaintenanceBills.js (Generate modal). Recurring console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: MaintenanceBills.js uses window.prompt() for cancel/exclude reasons (line 86, 115). Browser-native prompt is jarring on mobile and not styled — replace with a small shadcn Dialog with a textarea for consistent UX.

ResidentPages.js MyBills 'Verified history' section is hidden entirely when verifiedBills.length===0. That is intentional but means toggle-history-btn data-testid won't be present in the common starter case. Consider always rendering the section header with a 0-count empty state for discoverability — or document this conditional behavior in the test plan.
SharedPages.js NoticesPage and ComplaintsPage delete uses window.confirm — same UX inconsistency as MaintenanceBills prompts. Consider a shadcn AlertDialog wrapper.

BazaarPage 'available' boolean conflates link.available || bazaarStatus.connected — these are two different concepts (link present vs external service connected). Worth disambiguating in the pill copy.
Multiple files duplicate the timeAgo helper inline; SharedPages.js exports it locally — extract to /lib/dateUtils.js to share with ResidentPages.js for DRY.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all Phase C elements found and functional; regressions clean

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test notices (TEST_PIN, TEST_NOPIN) — 1 deleted, 1 remained as TEST_NOPIN. Created 1 TEST_complaint as resident. Bills/maintenance unchanged. No DB-level seeding done.
